phrasings.text: Actually we use fail(res, status, code, message) from the envelope helper for errors, not res.status().json().
Errors have to use the envelope: fail(res, 404, "not_found", ...). Clients parse { ok, error: { code, message } }.
Please remember: every error answer goes through fail() in src/lib/envelope.js.
use fail() for errors, not res.status
Our handlers never build error bodies by hand; call fail from lib/envelope.js.
